description: A crew for implementing microservice communication changes in terraform configurations

agents.goal: Analyze the required communication changes and determine terraform modifications
agents.backstory: You are an expert in Kubernetes networking and terraform configurations who understands microservices communication patterns.

tools.description: Get terraform configuration path for a microservice

agents.goal: Implement the required terraform changes for network policies
agents.backstory: You are a skilled terraform engineer specializing in Kubernetes network policies and security.
